Class DBAPI

    • getPokemonInfo

      public static Pokemon getPokemonInfo(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException
      This function accepts a ResultSet and returns a Pokemon from data within the ResultSet
      Parameters:
      rs - - a ResultSet that contains all the information needed to generate a pokemon object.
      Returns:
      - A Pokemon object generated from the ResultSet The caller must position the cursor on a row before calling this method.
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the current row or a required column cannot be read

    • getAllPokemonAboveStat

      public static ArrayList<Pokemon> getAllPokemonAboveStat(String stat, int value)
      This function returns an ArrayList of pokemon with the given stat above the specified value
      Parameters:
      stat - - hp, attack, defense, special_attack, special_defense, or speed, ignoring case; spaces may be used instead of underscores
      value - - the exclusive lower limit for the stat
      Returns:
      - An ArrayList containing all pokemon above that stat value
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - - if the stat name is null or unsupported
